full_judgment: 55. Mr Mansurul Hoque Chowdhury, Senior Advocate appearing for opposite party No. 1 in the criminal revision submits that this is an established principle of criminal law that an accused-person is presumed to be innocent and if an accused is acquitted on trial, he enjoys double presumption of innocence. In the present case there is no direct evidence. Even the imaginary love affairs between Rabbani's wife Nipa and unfortunate victim Suman is not established by any sort of evidence, for which acquitted Rabbani can be suspected. His phone call or that of his wife was not inquired into by the IO and no connection between him and any of the confessing accused was established by any piece of evidence. Besides, the IO himself admitted that he had collected a report from Makbul Kader, Commander of BDR Cantonment at Feni. There is no reason to be involved in the occurrence on the part of Rabbani. The Court below rightly acquitted him and there is no legal ground to interfere with the judgment and order of his acquittal.
